media.description: For Ja'Kobi Gillespie and Maliq Brown, it was a wild 24-hour ride from a G League court in OKC to an NBA game with the Spurs.

items.title: Mitch Johnson hinted could be minutes for rookies Tarris Reed, Ja'Kobi Gillespie and Maliq Brown vs. Kings.
items.author: Jeff McDonald
items.body_excerpt:
Mitch Johnson hinted could be minutes for rookies Tarris Reed, Ja'Kobi Gillespie and Maliq Brown vs. Kings.

"If they play great, how good for them? And if they’re awful, what a learning lesson. ... 24 hours from now they’ll have a whole new perspective on whatever they go through tonight."

quote.author: Jeff McDonald
quote.text:
As a freshman at Michigan, Tarris Reed was glued to the bench, playing only in garbage time.

"I freaking hated it," he said.

In a similar situation with the Spurs, the rookie center has found patience to be not only a virtue, but a necessity.

items.title: Tarris Reed Jr. on learning from the example Jordan McLaughlin sets:
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Tarris Reed Jr. on learning from the example Jordan McLaughlin sets:

"Seeing J-Mac, especially in Utah, coming fresh off the bench and having an instant impact, and you just (go), 'Oh, man, I'm going to do that. I got to be ready like J Mac.' He shows up every day."
